issues.title: P02: RoleManifest schema (strict pydantic) with JSON Schema export
acceptance: every V1 manifest field is typed and strict
the exported JSON Schema matches the model (snapshot)
path and symlink escapes in permitted_paths are rejected

issues.title: P02: the four owned role bundles under agents/catalog/
acceptance: each role validates against RoleManifest
the reviewer grants no write path and no publish credential
the verifier has no repair capability
negative_cases: a persona.md asking for writes does not change the grant
issues.rollback: revert; the loader in P02-3 tolerates an absent catalog only in tests

issues.title: P02: CatalogLoader, CatalogValidator, RoleRegistry
issues.red_test: loading a tagged-YAML (!!python/object) manifest must raise PolicyDenied
acceptance: safe_load only
repeated loads give identical compiled contracts
unknown roles are rejected

issues.title: P02: RoleCompiler with fixed prompt precedence; roles list/show/validate CLI
issues.red_test: compiled prompt order must be owner task > acceptance > role instructions > knowledge
acceptance: hard controls are emitted as structured grants, never prompt text
CLI lists, shows and validates roles
an offline no-LLM demonstration runs
negative_cases: a role instruction trying to override owner task precedence

issues.title: P03: ExecutorPort, FakeExecutor and AgentFactory.mint/discharge
issues.red_test: a second mint with the same idempotency key must return the same lease
acceptance: MintRequest/Lease/Receipt are typed
mint is idempotent
discharge always yields a receipt, including on cancel
negative_cases: mint with an empty acceptance contract

issues.title: P03: OpenHandsExecutor adapter with a fail-closed compatibility probe
issues.red_test: with the SDK absent, doctor and mint must fail with an actionable error, never a fake success
acceptance: openhands-sdk pinned after license verification
verified imports only
one real tool invocation traced when Docker and a key exist

issues.title: P03: hardened Docker workspaces and a host-side tool policy gateway
issues.red_test: a reviewer worker writing to its snapshot must fail at the OS level
acceptance: non-root, dropped caps, pids/mem/cpu limits
network deny by default per role
cancellation kills the process tree and revokes the credential
